answer: A prism then splits each contribution into verifiable facets, so peers can cross-check behavior across epochs. One concrete mechanism: each agent must stake tokens and route every action through a unique identity grove, a bonded registry entry whose history is public. Sybils must fund and maintain many independent groves, each emitting a consistent signal over time, which multiplies attacker cost far beyond the reward of a single fake identity. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
